Project Role :Business Architect

Translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
Must have skills :Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:
Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade solutions using Generative and Agentic AI frameworks that drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation.Roles & Responsibilities:Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to address complex business challenges, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise workflows for measurable impact.Professional & Technical Skills:Strong grasp of Generative and Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Summary:
As an Associate Manager ?? D365 Supply Chain + AI Specialist, you will work closely with business stakeholders to analyze SCM processes, configure Dynamics 365 SCM, execute testing, and design automation opportunities using AI and Power Platform. You are expected to learn emerging Microsoft technologies rapidly and apply them in client engagements.Roles & Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and perform process mapping.
  • Configure and deliver D365 SCM functions (Procurement, Inventory, WMS, Planning, TMS etc.).
  • Identify automation opportunities in SCM with AI (OCR, Copilot suggestions, approval workflows).
  • Execute fit-gap analysis, prepare functional design documents, and validate end-to-end process flows.
  • Build PoCs/demos using Power Platform / AI Builder / Copilot Studio.
  • Create design documentation, test scripts, and training materials.
  • Troubleshoot and address functional issues independently.
  • Continuously learn and apply new D365 and AI capabilities.
  • Contribute to creation of reusable assets, accelerators, and knowledge documentation.
  • Work with cross-functional teams (Finance, Commerce, CRM, Technical) to ensure seamless solution alignment.
  • Mentor consultants and analysts in the project; promote high-quality delivery standards.Professional & Technical Skills:
  • 8+ years in D365 SCM / AX functional consulting.
  • Hands-on exposure to Power Automate / AI Builder / Dataverse.
  • Strong analytical and requirement-gathering skills.Good-to-Have Skills:
  • Experience in manufacturing or distribution environments.
  • Understanding of Azure Cognitive Services or OCR automation.
  • Awareness of DevOps and Agile delivery practices.Behavioral Competencies:
  • Fast learner with a strong curiosity for new technologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking ability.
  • Strong verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to manage time, tasks, and client expectations independently.

    Additional Information:
  • Client-facing role with frequent stakeholder interactions.
  • This role is part of the elite consulting capability, focused on transformation and innovation not just traditional implementation.
  • Opportunity to upskill toward Solution Architect career path.

    Qualification
    15 years full time education

Summary:

Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization.Overview:We are seeking a seasoned Full Stack Enterprise Architect with deep expertise in designing and implementing application-heavy, multi-cloud enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applications, infrastructure and integration, with hands-on experience in .NET Core, MVC Framework and Python, as well as exposure to modern front-end technologies like React or Angular. A solid understanding of AI and its integration into enterprise systems is essential. This role will drive the architecture of scalable, secure, and innovative solutions to support business objectives across multiple cloud platforms. Key Responsibilities:Solution Architecture:Design end-to-end, application-heavy enterprise architectures that integrate infrastructure, applications, data and platforms across multi-cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Application Development Leadership:Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable applications with a focus on full-stack development, ensuring alignment with business goals. Integration Strategy:Architect seamless integrations between systems, applications, and third-party services using APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Multi-Cloud Strategy:Develop and implement strategies for deploying and managing applications across multiple cloud platforms, ensuring portability, scalability, and cost optimization. Technology Leadership:Provide technical guidance on .NET, and Python-based backend systems, and modern front-end frameworks like React or Angular. AI Adoption:Incorporate GenAI/Agentic AI capabilities into enterprise applications, leveraging frameworks and tools to enhance productivity & functionality (e.g., predictive analytics, automation). Infrastructure Design:Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design cloud-native solutions, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and IaC (Terraform, Bicep). Performance & Security:Ensure solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and security, adhering to industry standards and best practices. Stakeholder Collaboration:Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions. Innovation & Trends:Stay updated on emerging technologies, including AI advancements, cloud trends, and full-stack development practices, to drive continuous improvement.
Qualifications & Skills:Experience:12 to 20+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, with at least 3 to 5 years in a full-stack architect role focusing on application-heavy solutions. Proven track record of designing and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Hands-on experience with .NET Core, ASP.Net and Python for backend development. Exposure to front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks. Strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in enterprise systems. Expertise in integration patterns (e.g., REST, Azure Integration Services, GraphQL, Kafka, message queues) and microservices architecture. Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Fabrics, Hadoop, Spark) and data integration pipelines. Experience with infrastructure components such as containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and IaC tools (Terraform, Bicep). Understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and logging tools. Knowledge of enterprise security practices, including IAM, encryption, and compliance standards. Soft Skills:
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication and leadership abilities to guide cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.
  • Proactive, innovative mindset with a focus on delivering scalable solutions. Education:Bachelor??s or master??s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Fundamentals, TOGAF, DevOps Engineer Expert or similar) are a plus.

    Qualification
    15 years full time education

  • Fluency with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), object storage (S3/ADLS/GCS), networking (VPC/VNet, PrivateLink/Private Endpoints).

  • Performance tuning at scale:warehouse sizing, task concurrency, pruning/clustering, cost optimization.

Job Summary

Who were looking for: An AI Product Builder who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage and is excited to use AI to turn ideas into working solutions. Youre someone who likes getting your hands dirty, experimenting with new tools, and building and testing solutions quickly, with a strong bias toward action and real-world validation.

What the role is about: At Kraftshala, youll work on problems across student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. Youll identify opportunities, figure out what to build, and use AI, automation, and modern tools to turn ideas into working products, workflows, and systems. Youll work closely with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions from prototype to production.

What makes this role meaningful: Rather than spending most of your time writing requirements or waiting for development cycles, youll be expected to experiment, prototype, ship, and learn quickly.

Responsibilities

As an AI Product Builder at Kraftshala, youll be at the intersection of product, technology, and business. Youll work closely with teams across the organisation to understand how they work, spot opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

Youll be expected to move quickly from understanding to experimentation using AI and modern tools to explore different approaches, build prototypes, and learn what works. As solutions take shape, youll work with the right teams to refine, scale, and improve them.

A core expectation in this role is the ability to build quickly and learn through experimentation using AI-assisted development, LLMs, APIs, integrations, automation, and modular systems to turn ideas into usable solutions, validate them in real contexts, and iterate based on what you learn.

What youll own

  • Find Understand Problems: Work with users and teams to identify meaningful problems, understand what causing them, and figure out what is worth solving.
  • Build Prototype: Turn ideas into working prototypes, tools, workflows, and automations using AI and modern development tools. Metrics to measure: Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments shipped
  • Test Iterate: Put what you build in front of real users, learn from feedback and data, and improve the solution based on what you learn. Metrics to measure: Adoption, iteration velocity, solution effectiveness
  • Ship Improve: Work with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions into production and continuously improve them based on usage and impact. Metrics to measure: Delivery speed, adoption, business impact

How youll operate

  • You move fluidly between understanding the problem and building the solution
  • You use AI as a force multiplier across research, prototyping, development, and execution
  • You default to building and testing, rather than spending too long planning
  • Youre comfortable trying things that may not work and iterating quickly
  • You prioritise speed to insight and usable output over perfect upfront planning
  • You think in systems, not just features
  • You care about what happens after something is built adoption, impact, and outcomes

Monthly Outcomes

  • Month 1: Build a strong understanding of Kraftshala users, systems, and business priorities
  • Month 1: Identify and validate meaningful problems worth solving
  • Month 1: Build and ship at least one small prototype, automation, or workflow improvement
  • Month 2: Own a problem from understanding to solution
  • Month 2: Build, test, and iterate on prototypes using AI and modern tools
  • Month 2: Ship at least one meaningful product, workflow, or automation improvement
  • Month 3+: Take on increasingly complex problems and build solutions with greater autonomy
  • Month 3+: Run faster build-test-learn cycles and improve what you ship based on real-world feedback
  • Month 3+: Deliver solutions that create measurable improvements in user experience, revenue, or operational efficiency

Must Haves

  • 12 years of experience in Product, a builder, technical, or closely related role startup experience is a plus. (Were not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that just a proxy for your skill level.)
  • Have built and shipped something a digital product, tool, prototype, workflow, automation, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, APIs, automation, no-code/low-code, or modern development tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving contexts.
  • Strong user empathy, product intuition, and communication skills.

Job Summary

As the Entra Apps Factory Shift Lead, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant transition of enterprise applications, app registrations and associated identity/access integrations that must be re established in the destination tenant. This discipline is core to successful workload migration because application authentication, authorisation, secrets/certificates and trust relationships must be recreated and validated to keep business services functioning through cutover waves. You will run a 24x7 factory model: managing backlogs, enforcing runbooks, coordinating with security/identity stakeholders and ensuring evidence capture for every app remediated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead execution of Entra Apps migration/remediation runbooks during your shift, ensuring predictable throughput and quality gates.
  • Own triage for application access failures post tenant transition (SSO misconfig, missing claims, certificate/secret issues, redirect URI mismatch, conditional access blocks).
  • Coordinate recreation and validation of enterprise apps and app registrations in the target tenant, including keys/secrets/certs rotation and permissions re grant patterns where applicable.
  • Manage cross tenant access considerations that support collaboration and transition states (where used), ensuring correct governance and safe configuration.
  • Maintain shift backlog, prioritise by business criticality and cutover schedule and coordinate stakeholder validation where required.
  • Drive evidence capture: configuration proof, test results, sign in validation, rollback notes and completion records suitable for audit/governance.
  • Ensure operational handovers are crisp: open risks, high priority apps, dependencies and next actions clearly documented.
  • Coordinate with Devices/Shared Data/Power Platform/Power BI teams to resolve identity and app dependencies impacting wave execution.
  • Drive continuous improvement of runbooks, templates and test scripts to reduce time per app and minimise repeat defects.
  • Escalate complex vendor application issues with complete diagnostic evidence and clear business impact.

Who You Are

Must Have (or equivalent experience)

  • Delivered production tenant to tenant Entra Apps remediation (enterprise apps/app registrations) in your specialism, including cutover validation.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Microsoft Entra ID application constructs: enterprise applications, app registrations, service principals, permissions/consent and token/claim concepts.
  • Strong experience with secrets/certificates lifecycle, rotation planning and secure handling practices.
  • Experience working with conditional access and cross tenant access settings where relevant and understanding how these can block or permit access during transition phases.
  • Proven runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable operating in audited environments.
  • Ability to lead delivery in a 24x7 three shift model, including formal handovers and accountable shift outcomes.

Good to Have

  • SC 300 certification (or equivalent) and/or MS 102.
  • Microsoft Graph/PowerShell automation experience to accelerate inventory, recreation templates and validation checks.
  • Experience with SSO standards and patterns (SAML/OIDC/OAuth) and federated integrations with third party SaaS vendors.
  • Experience working with multi tenant organisations/collaboration constructs (B2B settings, controlled cross tenant relationships).
  • Strong security mindset: least privilege, access reviews and configuration drift control.

Interpersonal Consulting Skills

  • Structured, evidence driven leadership: avoids guesswork and enforces repeatability.
  • Confident communicator with technical and non technical stakeholders; explains risk/impact clearly.
  • Coaches engineers into consistent execution and strong operational habits (tickets, proof, testing).
  • Calm under pressure during cutovers; leads triage with discipline and prioritisation.
  • Strong dependency management behaviours; proactively removes blockers across disciplines.
  • Treats application owners and business teams professionally; sets expectations and drives timely validation.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: apps remediated/tested per shift vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of apps requiring rework after first validation.
  • MTTR: time to restore access for critical apps during wave cutovers.
  • Evidence capture: completeness of configuration proof and validation artefacts per app.
  • SLA: cutover readiness achieved on time; escalations raised early with sufficient evidence.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

  • This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

  • Monitor and assess security risks, threats, and vulnerabilities across all information systems, networks, and applications.

  • Implement security technologies such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), data loss prevention (DLP), and endpoint protection tools.

  • Conduct regular security testing, including vulnerability scans and penetration testing, to validate the security posture of systems.
  • Work closely with DevOps and engineering teams to integrate security practices into development and operational processes (DevSecOps).
  • Ensure the organization complies with secure coding standards and best practices in application development.
  • Stay current on the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and technologies, and recommend upgrades to security infrastructure as necessary.

Must have Skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in information security, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in information security, risk management, or security compliance.

  • In-depth knowledge of information security principles, including network security, application security, encryption, identity management, and incident response.
  • Familiarity with security tools and technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, DLP, SIEM, endpoint security, and vulnerability management.

  • Strong understanding of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and their impact on security compliance.
  • Strong leadership skills and experience managing cross-functional teams or security operations.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC are highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in information security, Cybersecurity, or related field.
  • Hands-on experience with security automation and orchestration in a DevSecOps environment.
  • Experience working with security frameworks for regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance).
  • Familiarity with advanced threat detection and mitigation strategies.
  • Certifications in cloud security (e.g., AWS Certified Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate).

title: Staff Engineer- Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence
jobDescription:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.


As a Staff Engineer Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence, you will define and lead the technical direction of Safe s network reachability and attack-path intelligence capabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

You will be the hands-on architect behind systems that connect network topology, identities, vulnerabilities, security controls, and business-critical assets to determine how attackers can move through an enterprise environment.

You ll collaborate with product, backend, graph, data, AI, and platform teams to build scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready attack-path capabilities.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role. You will architect systems, build prototypes, write production-quality code, and help shape how Safe s CTEM platform identifies and breaks the attack paths that pose the greatest business risk.

Core Responsibilities:
  • Architect Safe s Attack Path Intelligence: Define the architecture and data model for network topology, effective reachability, trust boundaries, identities, vulnerabilities, controls, and attack paths across complex enterprise environments.
  • Build Core Attack Path Capabilities: Write production-quality code for network configuration parsing, reachability analysis, attack-graph construction, graph traversal, exposure chaining, and blast-radius computation. Build prototypes and evolve them into reliable, enterprise-scale services.
  • Model Effective Network Reachability: Derive actual connectivity from routing tables, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and segmentation policies rather than relying only on documented topology.
  • Model Attacker Movement: Build reasoning systems that connect exposed services, vulnerabilities, credentials, Active Directory privileges, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and access to critical assets.
  • Prioritize Actionable Attack Paths: Distinguish theoretical paths from reachable, exploitable, and business-critical attack paths. Incorporate exploitability, control effectiveness, asset criticality, and business impact into prioritization.
  • Enterprise Security Integrations: Design integrations with firewalls, routers, NAC, EDR, CMDB, Active Directory, vulnerability scanners, NetFlow, cloud platforms, and other enterprise security systems.
  • Countermeasure Intelligence: Build a vendor-neutral model for recommending segmentation, isolation, firewall-policy changes, access-control improvements, and compensating controls. Define validation, approval, safety, and rollback requirements.
  • AI and Graph Integration: Partner with other engineers to ensure attack-path explanations and countermeasure recommendations are evidence-backed, explainable, technically accurate, and governed through deterministic safety policies.
  • Validation & Governance: Build reference attack scenarios, simulation environments, regression datasets, and validation frameworks to verify attack paths and proposed countermeasures without introducing unacceptable operational risk.
  • Mentor & Multiply: Guide backend, graph, security, and platform engineers through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, engineering standards, and complex security-domain decisions.
Minimum Qualifications:

Experience: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, network security, security product engineering, exposure management, or related areas, with a strong record of building and shipping production systems.

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, Go, Java, or a similar backend language
  • Recent experience writing and shipping production-quality software not only providing architectural or advisory guidance
  • Strong system-design, API-design, data-modeling, and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Experience implementing graph traversal, rule-processing, network automation, configuration analysis, or security analytics
  • Ability to independently prototype complex ideas and evolve them into scalable production capabilities
  • Familiarity with graph databases and graph-processing technologies

Network Security

  • Deep understanding of enterprise on-premises, cloud, and hybrid networks
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and network segmentation
  • Experience deriving effective reachability across complex network configurations
  • Understanding of firewall-policy analysis, change validation, control effectiveness, and security misconfiguration detection

Attack Path & Identity Security

  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Kerberos, identity privilege paths, credential exposure, privilege escalation, and lateral movement
  • Experience with attack graphs, attack-path analysis, threat modelling, breach simulation, or exposure chaining
  • Ability to connect vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with network reachability and attacker behaviour
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common enterprise attack techniques

Product Engineering: Experience translating deep security-domain knowledge into scalable products, analytical systems, or security-platform capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building attack-path, network digital-twin, microsegmentation, or CTEM products
  • Experience with graph databases and large-scale graph computation
  • Experience with BloodHound, Nmap, Zeek, Wireshark, NetFlow, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Forward Networks, XM Cyber, RedSeal, AlgoSec, Tufin, FireMon, or comparable platforms
  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, Juniper, or other enterprise network-control technologies
  • Exposure to Pentera, AttackIQ, Picus, Horizon3.ai, or other security-validation platforms
  • Background spanning both offensive and defensive security
  • Experience safely validating security controls in production-like environments
  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP networking
  • Experience working with large, complex, and highly regulated enterprises
  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CISSP, CCIE Security, CCNP Security, or GIAC
  • Published research, patents, open-source contributions, or previous technical leadership in security-product engineering is a strong plus
If you re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that s redefining security, we want to hear from you!

Job Summary
Bajaj Finserv Web is a critical component of the company's omnipresence strategy. You will be working with India's largest NBFC's web technology stack, encompassing over 40 business lines and 230+ features, with nearly 500 million traffic and managing over 30,000 webpages.

The Principal Architect is the design authority for this entire customer-facing digital estate and leads a group of 4-5 Technical Architects spanning AEM and content platforms, frontend frameworks, cloud and platform engineering, and AI and data. The role is deliberately multi-stack: it is accountable for a single coherent North-star architecture across content, experience, services, cloud and intelligence layers, rather than for the depth of any one stack. Deep, demonstrable AI engineering capability is a mandatory requirement of the role - the Principal Architect defines how LLM, agentic and evaluation-driven systems are architected, governed and run inside a regulated NBFC. Above all, the role exists to change the status quo: to identify where the current architecture, engineering practice or cost base is structurally limiting, and to sponsor and land the initiatives that move it, with measurable outcomes on performance, velocity, resilience and total cost of ownership.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Ensure architecture, decision records and runbooks are documented, current and usable, so that platform knowledge does not sit only with individuals.
  • 5. Leadership and Team Development: Lead, coach and grow 2-4 Technical Architects - set objectives, conduct reviews, close appraisal cycles on time, and build a genuine succession bench for each stack.
  • Deliberately build cross-stack breadth in the architect group so that the organisation is not exposed to single-person dependency in any technology area.
  • Own senior technical hiring - define the bar for GB06 and GB05 bands, chair architecture-level interview panels, and hold the line on technical depth including the mandatory AI engineering bar.
  • Determine individual training and development plans, sponsor certification and conference participation, and create visible technical career paths for engineers below the architect band.
  • Inspire and influence across the organisation - present technology strategy, priorities, quarterly plans and investment cases to Vertical Head, CIO and MD level forums and secure buy-in.

  • Keep delivery activity firmly connected to business outcomes, working with cross-functional teams on acquisition, conversion and cross-sell targets.

  • Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit as the technical counterpart on reviews, findings and remediation, and represent the platform architecture in regulatory and audit engagements.
  • Own cloud and platform cost architecture - FinOps discipline, unit economics, commitment and reservation strategy, egress and inference cost control - and hold the group accountable to the cost envelope.

  • Define, publish and govern reference architectures, architecture principles and non-functional standards covering security, performance, scalability, availability, observability and cost, and make them binding across all PODs and partner vendors.
  • Own the multi-year technology roadmap and sequencing across concurrent modernisation programmes, ensuring each stack's roadmap accounts for new and yet-to-release capabilities of the underlying products and frameworks.

  • 2. AI Engineering and Applied Intelligence (mandatory core of the role): Own the architecture for LLM and agentic systems across the estate - model selection and routing, retrieval and context architecture, orchestration and workflow durability, tool and function design, memory and state handling, and cost and latency engineering at production scale.
  • Define the evaluation discipline for all AI systems: deterministic gates, LLM-as-judge scoring, golden datasets, regression harnesses, drift detection and human-in-the-loop review, so that AI capability is released against evidence rather than demonstration.

  • Drive AI into the software delivery lifecycle itself - agentic coding harnesses, automated review and test generation, design-to-code pipelines and documentation automation - with instrumented, measured impact on engineering throughput and defect rates rather than anecdotal adoption claims.

  • Run a disciplined POC and benchmarking practice with pre-agreed success criteria, cost envelopes and kill conditions, so that experiments conclude rather than accumulate.

Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: a fleet of specialized AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Someone has to own the product, the roadmap, and the team behind it. That is this role.

Our customers include many of the worlds largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies dont, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can t do it exceptionally well, we don t do it. It s how weve assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it s how we re reinventing what s possible every day.
This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.
About the team
Core Engineering builds the firmware and cloud platform that Plumes next-generation architecture is built on. We deliver the Plume Firmware Agent (PFA) across three reference platforms - RDK-B , prplOS / prplMesh , and OpenWRT / OpenSync - The highly scalable cloud core manages a fleet of connected devices over standards-based protocols.

About the role
Were hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of Core Engineerings delivery teams. This is a hands-on-adjacent people-leadership role: you own the health, growth and output of a team of roughly 10-30 firmware, backend and QA engineers, and you are close enough to the technology to make real calls on scope, sequencing and trade-offs.
You will not be the only voice in the room. Core runs with technical leads, TPMs, product owners and QA leads across multiple regions, and the manager who succeeds here is the one who makes that distributed system work.

What youll do:
Lead the team
  • Manage, coach and grow a globally distributed team of firmware, cloud and QA engineers; run 1:1s, career development, performance and compensation cycles.
  • Own hiring for your team end to end - sourcing partnership, interview loop design, closing, and onboarding that gets new engineers productive on a complex embedded + cloud stack.
  • Build a culture where code review, design review and demos are collaborative rather than transactional - our review norms deliberately keep PRs open for cross-region input, and that only works if managers protect it.
Own delivery
  • Drive sprint planning, review, demo and retrospective for your team on the CORE board; keep the backlog groomed, parented and honestly estimated.
  • Take quarterly product requirements through grooming into epics and stories, in partnership with Product Management, Product Owners and the TPM - and push back early when scope, dependencies or capacity dont add up.
  • Own release readiness for your area across Alpha, Beta and GA: entry/exit criteria, blocker triage, validation coverage, and a clear-eyed status your leadership can act on.
  • Track and unblock cross-team dependencies with Product Engineering, Integration Engineering, Cloud/CSS, DevOps and InfoSec.
Own technical direction with your leads
  • Partner with technical leads and architects on platform strategy - the move from a stateful, driver-coupled OpenSync design toward stateless, standards-compliant, SDK-conformant operation over USP.
  • Make and defend architectural trade-offs across three device platforms and the cloud services above them, including what gets upstreamed versus carried downstream.
  • Raise the engineering bar on the things that quietly decide velocity: build times, branch hygiene, test automation, flaky testbeds, and observability.
What were looking for:
Leadership Skills
  • 13+ years in software engineering with 3+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.
  • Strong technical grounding in embedded Linux networking - Wi-Fi/networking firmware, an embedded build system (Yocto/OpenWrt/OpenEmbedded), C, and debugging on real hardware - or in distributed cloud services with genuine fluency in the device side.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a release train: you have shipped firmware or platform software into production at scale; with QA and release gates you were accountable for.
  • Experience leading a distributed team across time zones , and the operating discipline that requires - written communication, asynchronous decision-making, and deliberate inclusion of remote colleagues.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed organisation with technical leads, TPMs and product owners you influence but dont manage.
Technical Skills
  • Direct experience with one or more of RDK-B , prplOS/prplMesh , or OpenSync/OpenWrt .
  • Working knowledge of Broadband Forum TR-369 (USP) and TR-181 , and/or Wi-Fi Alliance EasyMesh .
  • Background in the CPE / broadband gateway ecosystem - ODM and chipset vendor SDKs, operator certification, interop testing.
  • Familiarity with the surrounding toolchain: Jenkins, GitHub-based workflows, Artifactory, containerised services, Kubernetes/EKS, MQTT, PKI and certificate management.
  • Experience with test automation for embedded systems (e.g. Boardfarm, TDK, cloudless test harnesses) and with managing QA as a first-class discipline rather than an afterthought.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and leadership to interpret and translate requirements across the full VisaAssist portfolio spanning inbound channels (Chat, Email, Portal), agent worker routing logic, and platform evolution roadmaps incorporating feedback into technical architecture decisions and working code.

  • Lead system design and architecture, personally architecting and building core infrastructure components: intent classification models, agent routing logic, MCP protocol adapters, and resilience patterns across the distributed multi-agent system.
  • Drive program delivery across the full VisaAssist portfolio intent classification & routing accuracy improvements, agent worker ecosystem (MsgProcessing, CrmDynamics, InvoiceInvestigator, ClientProfile, Transaction Management), MCP protocol adoption and expansion across external services (CRM, Invoice, CAD CP servers), and platform reliability.
  • Write production code daily (60%+ of time), personally implementing the most complex features across the full stack FastAPI endpoints, LangChain agent orchestration, Pydantic v2 schemas, async NATS handlers, and Docker/Kubernetes configurations.

  • Implement LangChain agent patterns including multi-hop MCP and dynamic schema composition; prototype emerging technologies (agentic AI frameworks, MCP protocol evolution, RAG advancements) and recommend technical direction based on hands-on evaluation.

  • Build operational resilience implement NATS messaging failure recovery patterns, manage platform uptime, and drive SLA adherence for Chat/Portal real-time latency, Email throughput, and external service availability.
  • Lead code reviews and enforce coding standards including Pydantic validation patterns, LangChain agent design, async FastAPI endpoints, and security-first practices ensuring quality across the full Python/FastAPI codebase.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to address security assessments and implement solutions for findings including API Key Auth, mTLS, OAuth2, PCI-DSS log redaction, and input guardrails (CSAM, injection, SSRF, abuse filtering); teach security-first development practices across the team.
  • Mentor and develop engineers through hands-on pair programming, code reviews, and technical guidance on LangChain agent patterns, MCP protocol implementation, and RAG pipeline optimization; empower team members to own agent worker design and individual microservice delivery.
  • Remain current in skills by continuously evaluating emerging agentic AI frameworks, MCP protocol evolution, and RAG advancements, and investing in team capability growth across the VisaAssist architecture and NATS pub/sub patterns.
  • Forecast labor and support fiscal planning project labor needs for agent worker development, infrastructure capacity, and LLM/GenAI API cost projections; support workforce planning during QBR accounting for platform growth, operational burden, and technical debt reduction.
  • Keep stakeholders and leadership informed of progress across epics, program delivery milestones, and overall platform health for the VisaAssist agent ecosystem.

  • Experience in Java EE technologies, Open-Source frameworks including Spring, React, JavaScript, HTML5, and Web Services (REST/RPC).
  • Experience on microservices, containerization, and ability to quickly build and drive team to support future systems.
  • Experience evaluating business requirements and translating them into technical design documents.
  • Experience in Design Patterns and data modelling.
  • Experience in Kafka and other No-SQL databases.
  • Solid understanding and experience working with Database systems like MySQL and MSSQL.
  • Experience working on application servers like Apache Tomcat, OS platforms like UNIX, Windows, and Linux.
  • Experience with build automation tools including Maven/Gradle/Jenkins/Grunt.
  • Exposure and good knowledge on web application security.
  • Experience in version control tools: BitBucket, Git or similar.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Programming Languages: Expert-level Python development including async/await architectures, high-performance API design (FastAPI), advanced type systems (Pydantic v2), and serialization optimization (orjson). Ability to set and enforce coding standards across teams.

  • Distributed Systems: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures, NATS/Kafka messaging systems, agent-to-agent communication patterns, distributed caching, connection pooling, and failover strategies.

jobDescription:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We''re all in on this mission. If you are too, let''s talk.
Get to know Okta
Okta is The World''s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.
At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box we''re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.
Join our team! We''re building a world where Identity belongs to you.
Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier-0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.
The Engineering Architect Team
The Architecture team is a small group of very senior engineers reporting to our VP of Engineering Excellence, working broadly across the organization in collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Security. We partner deeply with other Engineering teams for large projects, and provide direction and architectural guidance for smaller initiatives. We have a dual-pronged charter to "level up the tech stack and level up the people stack" via both technical contributions and partnerships and mentoring.
The Role
Auth0 is a developer product at its core and increasingly, the developers building with us aren''t just humans. AI agents are now a first-class consumer of our SDKs, APIs, and documentation.
This role owns the architectural vision for how Auth0 is experienced across three dimensions: DX (Developer Experience how human developers build with Auth0), UX (User Experience how users experience Auth0 products), and AX (Agentic Experience how AI agents interact with and build on Auth0).
You''ll work across our SDK ecosystem, public APIs, documentation, and product surfaces to ensure that every touchpoint is consistent, delightful, and easy to build on whether the builder is a human or an agent.
You''ll also contribute directly to how we build internally: creating the skills, guardrails, and patterns that our own in-house agents use, ensuring that agent-assisted development at Auth0 produces the same high-quality, consistent output as human-led development.
What you''ll be doing
  • Define and drive the architectural vision for DX, UX, and AX across Auth0''s public products, SDKs, and APIs
  • Identify and address inconsistencies across Auth0''s product surfaces, establishing patterns and standards that make the experience feel unified and intentional
  • Architect and contribute to the SDK and API design layer, ensuring our developer-facing interfaces are ergonomic, consistent, and built for both human and agent consumers
  • Design and build agent skills, guardrails, and contextual tooling (MCP servers, SKILL.md, llms.txt, structured documentation) that enable agents to build correctly with Auth0
  • Embed within Engineering teams for large initiatives, providing architectural guidance and lighter-touch direction for smaller efforts
  • Partner closely with the Design team as a key stakeholder, ensuring engineering implementation reflects and reinforces the product''s UX direction
  • Contribute to Auth0''s Developer Experience Principles in practice not just as guidance, but through hands-on implementation that raises the bar
  • Lead by doing: reviewing, prototyping, and contributing code across SDKs, tooling, and documentation systems
  • Participate in our Engineering Leadership Team with other architects, directors, and executives
  • Mentor and uplevel engineers across the organization on experience-focused architecture
What you''ll bring to the role
  • Experience : 15 to 20 year .
  • Deep experience designing developer-facing products: SDKs, APIs, CLIs, documentation systems, or developer portals
  • A strong point of view on what great DX looks like and the ability to identify, articulate, and fix where it falls short
  • Familiarity with the emerging AX space: agent-readable documentation formats, MCP servers, agent skills, and how AI agents consume APIs and tooling auth0.com
  • Knowledge of Identity protocols such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML, and how they surface in developer-facing products
  • Experience working across multiple product surfaces to drive consistency you''ve seen what fragmentation looks like and know how to fix it
  • Hands-on coding ability: this is not a purely advisory role; you''ll be expected to build, prototype, and contribute directly
  • Very strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and designers
  • Ability to drive technical decisions to conclusion while balancing quality, velocity, and pragmatism
  • Excellence at creating clarity and alignment across teams without direct authority
Extra credit:
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open source SDKs or libraries
  • Familiarity with structured content and documentation systems designed for LLM consumption (llms.txt, OpenAPI, structured changelogs)
  • Experience with frontend or full-stack development, particularly in the context of developer tooling or product surfaces like Universal Login
